user.title: Recorder Studio
user.description: Adds a sidebar panel to manage the recorder (SQLite only).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Recorder Studio is already set up.

disk_low.title: Disk space is running low
disk_low.description: Only {free} ({percent}%) is left on the disk that holds the Home Assistant database ({database}). Free up space, for example by excluding noisy entities or lowering the retention in Recorder Studio, then repack the database.

disk_filling.title: The database is filling the disk
disk_filling.description: At the current growth the disk (free: {free}, database: {database}) is full in about {days} days. Exclude noisy entities in Recorder Studio or lower the retention.

db_growth.title: The database is growing fast
db_growth.description: The recorder database grew {percent}% in the last week (now {database}). Open Recorder Studio to see which entities add the most.
